incidents.observation: All nine hosted observations failed the ledger-reconciliation assertions because the independent effect ledger received zero requests, while the rollout records the exec_command tool call with an output. The same controller passed all assertions on the development host, where the sandboxed tool reached the loopback ledger.
incidents.suspected_cause: The effect transport (loopback HTTP from inside the workspace-write sandbox) behaves differently on the hosted ubuntu-24.04 image than on the development host; the tool output text was not captured in the first controller revision, so the exact failure mode (connection blocked, command unavailable, or sandbox policy difference) is not yet evidenced.
incidents.disposition: Observations quarantined to quarantined-results/ and excluded from the audit until the diagnosis closes. They are not counted as product failures.
incidents.repair_plan: Capture bounded tool-output text in observations; run a hosted diagnostic probe (sandbox network reachability, curl availability, in-turn effect attempt); then either fix the harness transport (for example file-based effects inside the writable workspace) and rerun REL-02, or record a product boundary observation if the sandbox itself refuses the declared network_access grant.
